settings.title: The Gift Box
settings.for_who: For the friend who reads every label
settings.body: Four everyday basics, packed in our gift box: body lotion, lip balm, bar soap and deodorant. Choose a kit: Gentle is mostly unscented, Calm leans on lavender, and Fresh brings coconut, tangerine and tea tree.

settings.title: Four jars of body cream: keep one, give three
settings.for_who: For a few people at once
settings.body: Our Coconut Moisturizer starts from a 7-ingredient base and goes on thick enough for heels, hands and elbows, the spots that dry out first in winter. Four jars covers you and three people on your list.

settings.title: Head-to-Toe: one of everything
settings.for_who: For someone switching their whole routine
settings.body: Seven products in one order: body lotion, body cream, deodorant, toothpaste, bar soap, lip balm and foaming hand soap. Choose the Gentle kit or the Fresh kit.

settings.heading: What customers say
settings.quote_1: I'm obsessed with all things Real Skin Care. This is THE moisturizer for Wisconsin winters for my whole family. It's long lasting and doesn't feel greasy. We use it all over and love it!
settings.quote_2: Incredibly soft. Doesn’t make you feel greasy or sticky after use. It makes you feel incredibly moisturized.
settings.quote_3: The smell is perfect & it just glides onto the skin like butter! It doesnt leave a greasy residue like some other brands!

settings.title: The Sensitive Skin Set
settings.for_who: For the person who skips anything scented
settings.body: Our Pure Unscented body cream and body lotion together. No essential oils and no added fragrance, just the base ingredients, so it suits sensitive skin.

settings.title: One jar of body cream
settings.for_who: For a small gift that still feels generous
settings.body: A 4oz jar of Coconut Moisturizer in the scent of your choice. It goes on like butter and works in without a slick film, and used every night one jar lasts about a month.

settings.title: A lip balm four-pack for the stockings
settings.body: Four coconut oil lip balms in one pack. Pick a single flavor or the Variety Pack and split them across four stockings. Safe for kids, too.

settings.heading: Good to know
settings.note_1: Orders over $45 ship free in the US.
settings.note_2: Beeswax firms up in the cold. Warm a little cream between your fingers and it spreads easily.
settings.note_3: Sold-out gifts drop off this list on their own, so everything you see here can ship.

settings.headline: {count} gifts for people who read the label
settings.intro: Every gift here is made with coconut oil and a short ingredient list you can read in one breath. Each pick links to its own page, where you choose the scent.
settings.hero_alt: Real Skin Care coconut body care gifts
settings.closing: Every order has our 30-day guarantee. If it isn't loved, email us within 30 days and we will refund you. Nothing needs to be sent back.
